title: US x Iran ceasefire extended by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if there is an official extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement between the United States and Iran announced on April 7, 2026, defined as a publicly announced and mutually agreed extension to the halt in direct military engagement between the United States and Iran, by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Both extensions of the April 7 ceasefire and new agreements scheduled to take effect before or at the initial agreement's scheduled end will be considered extensions of the ceasefire agreement, provided there is no period during which no ceasefire is in effect.

If a qualifying agreement is officially reached before the resolution date, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of whether the ceasefire extension ultimately takes effect. 

An extension of the ceasefire agreement requires clear public confirmation from both the United States government and the government of Iran that they have agreed to halt military hostilities against one another for longer than the initially agreed two-week period, or for an official extension of the ceasefire agreement in place to be otherwise confirmed by an overwhelming consensus of media reporting.

Any form of informal understanding, backchannel communication, de-escalation, or unilateral pause in hostilities without a confirmed agreement on a qualifying extension will not qualify. Similarly, newly agreed-upon humanitarian pauses, limited operational pauses, or temporary tactical stand-downs will not qualify.

A newly agreed-upon broader peace deal will qualify if it includes a qualifying extension of the ceasefire agreement/halt in military hostilities. Agreements that outline future negotiations or de-escalation measures, but do not explicitly commit to extending the ceasefire, will not qualify.

This market’s resolution will be based on official statements from the United States government and the government of Iran. However, an overwhelming consensus of credible media reporting confirming that an official ceasefire extension agreement has been reached will suffice.

eventMetadata.context_description: President Trump indefinitely extended the US-Iran ceasefire on April 21, 2026—originally a two-week truce from April 8 mediated by Pakistan—citing internal divisions in Tehran that require time for a unified proposal amid ongoing Islamabad talks. The US naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz persists, while Iran's latest April 28 proposal to reopen it for sanctions relief faces uncertain US response, with negotiations stalling per recent reports including the UAE's OPEC exit. No verified military actions have broken the fragile halt in hostilities, but traders eye diplomatic breakthroughs or escalations, lacking a firm deadline for permanent de-escalation or broader peace deal.

eventMetadata.context_description: With the Los Angeles Lakers holding a 3-1 series lead over the Houston Rockets in their first-round Western Conference playoff matchup, Game 5 at Crypto.com Arena carries elimination stakes for Houston, where the Lakers boast home-court advantage and deeper star power. Kevin Durant has been officially ruled out for the Rockets with a left ankle sprain, missing his third straight game after returning briefly in Game 2, severely hampering their scoring punch amid a gritty 115-96 Game 4 road win that exposed Lakers' defensive lapses. LeBron James (left ankle sprain), Anthony Davis (right adductor strain), and Austin Reaves (oblique) remain questionable per latest injury reports, while recent form shows Lakers' OT thriller in Game 3 underscoring their resilience despite back-to-back risks and playoff intensity. Traders weigh Houston's momentum against LA's rest edge and historical playoff poise in closeouts.

eventMetadata.context_description: France holds a slim edge in trader consensus at 16% implied probability following their ascent to No. 1 in the latest FIFA men's rankings on April 1, just ahead of Spain and Argentina after dominant World Cup qualifying campaigns capped by late-March playoff resolutions that secured all top contenders without major injuries. The tightly bunched odds—Spain at 15%, England 11%, Argentina and Brazil tied at 9%—reflect parity among European and South American powerhouses, with intact squads featuring peak-form stars like Mbappé, Yamal, Messi, and Vinícius Jr., tactical depth from recent continental successes, and navigable group stage paths in the expanded 48-team draw. Unpredictable knockout dynamics and 50 days until kickoff keep the race wide open.

eventMetadata.context_description: The Cleveland Cavaliers host the Toronto Raptors in Game 5 of their first-round NBA playoffs series, tied 2-2 after Toronto's resilient road wins in Games 3 and 4 to erase Cleveland's 2-0 lead from dominant home victories. Raptors guard Immanuel Quickley remains out with a right hamstring strain, his fourth straight missed playoff game, straining Toronto's backcourt depth amid other ailments like Scottie Barnes' lingering shoulder issue. Cavaliers are largely healthy, with Jarrett Allen managing a knee concern but available, and Donovan Mitchell past his ankle sprain; home-court advantage and superior regular-season form (Cavs won East top seed) bolster trader consensus favoring Cleveland, though Raptors' momentum and upset potential keep the matchup competitive.

title: Will the Iranian regime fall by April 30?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Islamic Republic of Iran’s current ruling regime is overthrown, collapsed, or otherwise ceases to govern by April 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This requires a broad consensus of reporting indicating that core structures of the Islamic Republic (e.g. the office of the Supreme Leader, the Guardian Council, IRGC control under clerical authority) have been dissolved, incapacitated, or replaced by a fundamentally different governing system or otherwise lost de facto power over a majority of the population of Iran. This could occur via revolution, civil war, military coup, or voluntary abdication, but only qualifies if the Islamic Republic no longer exercises sovereign power.

Routine political events such as elections, reforms, or leadership succession do not qualify. Internal coups or power shifts that preserve the Islamic Republic’s core structures also do not qualify. Only a clear break in continuity—such as a new provisional government, revolutionary council, or constitution replacing the Islamic Republic will qualify.

Partial loss of territory or challenges from rebel or exile groups will not qualify unless the Islamic Republic no longer administers the majority of the Iranian population within Iran. 

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket reflects near-unanimous confidence that the Iranian regime will not fall by April 30, 2026, driven by its sustained coercive control despite unprecedented pressures. Following U.S.-Israeli strikes on February 28 that killed Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, triggering the 2025–2026 protests and economic collapse, the regime has maintained power through IRGC-led crackdowns, mass arrests exceeding 1,000 in March alone, executions of dissidents, and internet shutdowns—now extending into April with reports of continued killings in urban centers. eventMetadata.context_description: WTI crude oil front-month futures have surged over 16% in the past five days to around $108 per barrel as of April 30, 2026, propelled by escalating U.S.-Iran tensions and fears of prolonged supply disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz amid stalled talks. The United Arab Emirates' exit from OPEC effective May 1 heightens uncertainty over production quotas, potentially challenging OPEC+ discipline. Recent EIA data shows U.S. crude inventories at 459.5 million barrels—1% above the five-year average—with draws supporting prices amid steady global demand. Traders monitor upcoming weekly EIA reports, OPEC+ output decisions, and geopolitical developments for volatility as the month closes.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: US-Iran negotiations for a permanent peace deal remain stalled following a fragile ceasefire in early April 2026 that halted five weeks of US and Israeli strikes on Iranian targets and Iranian retaliation. Iran's April 28 proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz—contingent on the US lifting its naval blockade of Iranian ports—has met cautious review, with President Trump signaling low likelihood of acceptance absent concessions on nuclear enrichment curbs and sanctions relief. The blockade has forced Iran to store oil in makeshift facilities, heightening economic strain, while unresolved issues like ballistic missiles and regional proxies sustain tensions. No further talks are scheduled, underscoring trader consensus on formidable barriers to a comprehensive agreement soon, despite intermittent diplomatic signals.

title: Fed Decision in June?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's June 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for June 16-17, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their June meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

This aligns with CME FedWatch Tool signals and post-March repricing slashing 2026 cut bets. Realistic challenges include hotter-than-expected May CPI or weakening nonfarm payrolls ahead of the June 17 meeting.

title: Counter-Strike: Natus Vincere vs FaZe (BO3) - BLAST Rivals Group B
description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike Upper bracket semifinal 1 match between Natus Vincere and FaZe in the BLAST Rivals Group B, initially scheduled for April 29 at 4:00PM ET.

This market will resolve to "Natus Vincere" if Natus Vincere win the match against FaZe.

This market will resolve to "FaZe" if FaZe win the match against Natus Vincere.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Map 1: Odd/Even Total Kills?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Odd" if the total combined kills by both teams in Map 1 is an odd number.

This market will resolve to "Even" if the total combined kills by both teams in Map 1 is an even number.

"Total combined kills" includes all kills recorded during the match across all rounds, including kills during regulation rounds and overtime rounds if applicable. eventMetadata.context_description: HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. tops trader consensus at 49% implied probability for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, boosted by his high-profile congressional testimonies April 16-22, where he defended administration health reforms, challenged vaccine critics, and accused opponents of pharmaceutical ties—resonating with the GOP base amid ongoing agency overhauls. Vice President J.D. Vance follows at 38.8%, buoyed by incumbency but facing declining polling averages and prediction market slippage from prior highs near 60%. Secretary of State Marco Rubio's 21.1% reflects CPAC straw poll gains and Senate influence. President Trump's term limits bar a reelection bid, positioning early primary positioning ahead of 2026 midterms.

title: Presidential Election Winner 2028
description:
The 2028 US Presidential Election is scheduled to take place on November 7, 2028.

This market will resolve to the person who wins the 2028 US Presidential Election. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No.”

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race for the same candidate by the inauguration date (January 20, 2029) this market will resolve based on who is inaugurated.

eventMetadata.context_description: Vice President JD Vance holds a slim edge in trader consensus for the 2028 presidential election winner at 19.3% implied probability, just ahead of California Governor Gavin Newsom at 17.6%, with Senator Marco Rubio third at 10.9%, driven by recent head-to-head polls like UMass Lowell's late-March survey showing Vance up 33%-30% against Newsom amid fragmented Democratic contenders. Vance's lead stems from his incumbency advantage, high-profile diplomatic efforts including Iran ceasefire talks and a new book "Communion" fueling speculation, though odds have slipped on concerns over Trump administration performance. Newsom's surge reflects his national book tour and vocal opposition positioning, while Rubio gains from his Secretary of State role and contrasting foreign policy stances. The tight race persists due to the distant timeline, open Democratic primary, and 2026 midterm outcomes that could reshape party nominees and momentum.

eventMetadata.context_description: Gavin Newsom leads trader consensus at 27% implied probability for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination, reflecting his elevated national profile as California's term-limited governor, vocal Trump administration critiques, and strong showings in recent New Hampshire and national polls amid the party's post-2024 regrouping. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez trails at 9% buoyed by progressive appeal and youth voter support in surveys, while Kamala Harris at 8% faces headwinds from her 2024 defeat despite signaling interest at the April National Action Network convention where potential contenders gathered. Jon Ossoff and Pete Buttigieg follow with appeal as young senators and a 2020 primary veteran, respectively, in this fragmented field lacking a clear frontrunner. Consolidation could hinge on 2026 midterm performances in battleground states, early fundraising dominance, DNC endorsements, and responses to economic or policy challenges through the 2027-2028 primary calendar.

title: LoL: Sentinels vs FlyQuest (BO5) - Esports World Cup North America Qualifier Playoffs
description:
This market refers to the LoL Grand final match between Sentinels and FlyQuest in the Esports World Cup North America Qualifier Playoffs, initially scheduled for April 29 at 2:00PM ET.

This market will resolve to "Sentinels" if Sentinels win the match against FlyQuest.

This market will resolve to "FlyQuest" if FlyQuest win the match against Sentinels.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: Sentinels enter the Esports World Cup 2026 North America Qualifier playoffs BO5 grand final against FlyQuest as the clear trader consensus favorite, driven by three straight series victories over their rivals, including a 2-1 LCS Spring Week 3 win on April 18 and a 2-1 qualifier upper bracket clash on April 23. Sentinels advanced undefeated through the bracket after a dominant 2-0 upset over Cloud9, showcasing strong macro execution and sidelane pressure under patch 26.9's evolving meta favoring skirmish-heavy comps. FlyQuest rebounded from an early loss to beat Team Liquid 2-1 yesterday, but their inconsistent botlane duos and vulnerability to Sentinels' jungle pathing remain key weaknesses in this high-stakes matchup for the sole EWC main event spot.

title: Counter-Strike: FURIA vs GamerLegion (BO3) - BLAST Rivals Group B
description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike Upper bracket semifinal 2 match between FURIA and GamerLegion in the BLAST Rivals Group B, initially scheduled for April 29 at 6:30PM ET.

This market will resolve to "FURIA" if FURIA win the match against GamerLegion.

This market will resolve to "GamerLegion" if GamerLegion win the match against FURIA.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Map 1: Odd/Even Total Kills?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Odd" if the total combined kills by both teams in Map 1 is an odd number.

This market will resolve to "Even" if the total combined kills by both teams in Map 1 is an even number.

"Total combined kills" includes all kills recorded during the match across all rounds, including kills during regulation rounds and overtime rounds if applicable. Team kills (friendly fire) and self-inflicted deaths (e.g., falling damage, own grenade) do not count as kills for the purposes of this market.

If no kills are recorded in Map 1, or if Map 1 is canceled (not played at all), or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Map 1 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: **FURIA entered BLAST Rivals Spring 2026 Group B upper bracket matchup as heavy trader favorites against lower-ranked GamerLegion, reflecting their #3 world ranking versus #31, recent mixed but tier-1 form (W-L-W-L-W entering), and 3-2 head-to-head edge with a 7-4 map lead.** Brazilian stars KSCERATO (1.22 rating in loss), FalleN, and molodoy brought LAN pedigree to Fort Worth's double-elim GSL group, where top three advance to playoffs alongside NAVI and FaZe; no roster changes or injuries reported for either side in past 30 days. GamerLegion's 70% three-month win rate, anchored by Snax, REZ (strong Nuke), PR (1.31 rating), hypex, and Tauson, fueled underdog value amid stable lineup post-early 2026 tweaks. Map bans (Dust2, Ancient, Overpass, Anubis) left Inferno (FURIA pick Nuke), but GL's execution on Nuke and Mirage comeback highlighted upset risks in BO3 format. FURIA now faces FaZe in lower bracket on April 30, while GL eyes NAVI for playoffs.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 24 - May 1, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 24 12:00 PM ET to May 1, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

title: LoL: Movistar KOI vs Team Vitality (BO3) - Esports World Cup EMEA Qualifier Playoffs
description:
This market refers to the LoL Upper bracket quarterfinal 4 match between Movistar KOI and Team Vitality in the Esports World Cup EMEA Qualifier Playoffs, initially scheduled for April 29 at 2:00PM ET.

This market will resolve to "Movistar KOI" if Movistar KOI win the match against Team Vitality.

This market will resolve to "Team Vitality" if Team Vitality win the match against Movistar KOI.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.description:

title: Israel x Hezbollah Ceasefire extended by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if there is an official extension of the 10-day ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hezbollah announced on April 16, 2026, defined as a publicly announced and mutually agreed extension to the halt in direct military engagement between Israel and Hezbollah, by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Both extensions of the April 16 ceasefire and new agreements scheduled to take effect before or at the initial agreement's scheduled end will be considered extensions of the ceasefire agreement, provided there is no period during which no ceasefire is in effect.

If a qualifying agreement is officially reached before the resolution date, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of whether the ceasefire extension ultimately takes effect.

An extension of the ceasefire agreement requires clear public confirmation from both the Israeli government and Hezbollah that they have agreed to halt military hostilities against one another for longer than the initially agreed 10-day period, or for an official extension of the ceasefire agreement in place to be otherwise confirmed by an overwhelming consensus of media reporting.

Any form of informal understanding, backchannel communication, de-escalation, or unilateral pause in hostilities without a confirmed agreement on a qualifying extension will not qualify. Similarly, newly agreed-upon humanitarian pauses, limited operational pauses, or temporary tactical stand-downs will not qualify.

A newly agreed-upon broader peace deal will qualify if it includes a qualifying extension of the ceasefire agreement/halt in military hostilities. Agreements that outline future negotiations or de-escalation measures, but do not explicitly commit to extending the ceasefire, will not qualify.

This market’s resolution will be based on official statements from the Israeli government and Hezbollah. However, an overwhelming consensus of credible media reporting confirming that an official ceasefire extension agreement has been reached will suffice.

eventMetadata.context_description: A U.S.-brokered ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon, aimed at halting Israel-Hezbollah hostilities, took effect on April 16, 2026, and was extended by three weeks on April 23 following ambassador-level talks hosted by President Trump in Washington. Despite the extension—now set to run until mid-May—both sides report ongoing violations, including Israeli airstrikes on alleged Hezbollah infrastructure in southern Lebanon and Hezbollah rocket or drone launches toward northern Israel. IDF Chief Eyal Zamir stated on April 29 there is "no ceasefire" in southern Lebanon amid continued clashes. Israel has set a mid-May deadline for a permanent deal, with diplomacy focused on Hezbollah disarmament south of the Litani River and Israeli withdrawal conditions, though mutual accusations threaten escalation. UN Secretary-General welcomed the extension but urged full compliance.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus reflects a razor-thin Champions League race entering the semifinals' second legs, with Bayern Munich (31.5%) edging PSG (30.5%) and Arsenal (28.5%) amid high-stakes ties. PSG's thrilling 5-4 home win over Bayern in the first leg on April 28 squandered a three-goal lead but leaves the aggregate delicately poised ahead of Bayern's Allianz Arena return, where their knockout pedigree shines. Arsenal's resilient 1-1 draw at Atlético Madrid on April 29 positions them favorably for the Emirates decider, bolstered by strong away form despite injury concerns. Atlético (9%) trails as underdogs, but defensive grit keeps upsets viable in these evenly matched knockout clashes, underscoring the wisdom of crowds in pricing vulnerability for all frontrunners.

title: US x Iran diplomatic meeting by...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if there is a diplomatic meeting between representatives of the United States and Iran by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A diplomatic meeting refers to a deliberate meeting between representatives of the listed countries who are acting in an official capacity and are authorized to engage in negotiation or diplomacy regarding US-Iranian relations on behalf of their governments. Meetings conducted indirectly, for example, through designated mediators, facilitators, or interlocutors acting with the knowledge and authorization of the relevant governments, will qualify. 

Brief greetings, chance encounters, or talks otherwise not deliberately aimed at diplomacy or negotiation will not count. 

The meeting must be in-person and must be publicly acknowledged by either government or reported by a consensus of credible media. Remote meetings, phone calls, or other meetings where the relevant parties are not present will not count.

The resolution sources for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran, and a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: US-Iran diplomatic efforts remain stalled following the April 11-12 Islamabad talks—the first high-level direct meeting since 1979—where US Vice President JD Vance reported some progress but no agreement on reopening the Strait of Hormuz, nuclear constraints, or sanctions relief, amid an ongoing ceasefire and US naval blockade of Iranian ports. Iran submitted a new proposal on April 27 to reopen the strait while postponing nuclear negotiations, now under White House review, but Tehran insists on indirect channels via Pakistan, rejecting direct talks and blaming US "destructive habits" per Foreign Minister Araghchi's April 29 remarks in Russia. A widening rift in Iran's hardline establishment adds internal pressure, while traders eye potential mediated sessions in Islamabad soon; barriers to a qualifying diplomatic meeting include mutual red lines on escalation risks and verification hurdles.

title: Utah vs. Golden Knights
description:

eventMetadata.context_description: Vegas Golden Knights hold a 3-2 series lead over the Utah Mammoth in their Western Conference first-round Stanley Cup Playoffs matchup after a 3-2 Game 5 victory on April 29 at T-Mobile Arena, where Pavel Dorofeyev tallied twice and Shea Theodore added a goal amid tight checking and strong goaltending. Vegas rallied from a tied series post their dramatic 5-4 overtime road win in Game 4, showcasing resilience without injured center William Karlsson, while Utah misses Barrett Hayton (upper body). Game 6 shifts to Utah's Delta Center on May 1, where home-ice energy and Lawson Crouse's scoring could spark a comeback, though Vegas boasts superior road playoff record and momentum from two straight wins. Traders eye penalty kill efficiency (Vegas 85% series) and power-play opportunities in this best-of-seven.

eventMetadata.context_description: Finland's "Liekinheitin" by violinist Linda Lampenius and pop star Pete Parkkonen commands trader consensus at 35% implied probability, fueled by its unanimous UMK 2026 victory, rock-infused pop appeal blending classical flair with high-energy hooks, and dominance in OGAE polls and predictive models like The Model—bolstered by yesterday's hints at enhanced Vienna staging. Denmark's Søren Torpegaard Lund ("Før vi går hjem") surges to 13% on emotional electronic pop's jury simulation strength and recent odds climbs, while Greece's Akylas ("Ferto") matches at 14% via hyper-techno dance anthems primed for televote explosions post-promo tour. France's Monroe ("Regarde!") holds 10% as Big 5 direct finalist with rising-star buzz, but first rehearsals from May 2 could reshape this fragmented field ahead of semis on May 12/14 and final on 16.

title: Who will be confirmed as Fed Chair?
description:
This market will resolve according to the next individual formally confirmed as Chair of the Federal Reserve.

Formal confirmation as Chair of the Federal Reserve requires the Senate to confirm a nominee as Chair of the Federal Reserve. Recess appointments without Senate confirmation will not count. Senate confirmation of a listed individual as a member of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors will not alone qualify.

If no Senate confirmation for the position of Chair of the Federal Reserve has occurred by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market is official information from the U.S. Senate; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Kevin Warsh's commanding 99.2% implied probability as next Federal Reserve Chair stems from the Senate Banking Committee's 13-11 party-line approval of his nomination on April 29, advancing it to the full Senate floor ahead of Jerome Powell's May 15 term expiration. President Trump's March nomination followed Warsh's April 21 confirmation hearing, where he pledged Fed independence amid scrutiny from Democrats like Elizabeth Warren over potential White House influence. With Republican Senate control and possible Democratic support from figures like John Fetterman, traders view confirmation as nearly assured, reflecting historical patterns of nominees clearing committee hurdles. Realistic challenges include GOP defections, procedural holds, late financial disclosures, or an unexpected withdrawal, though Powell plans to remain on the Fed board post-term.

title: Brazil Presidential Election
description:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the listed candidate that wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If the result of this election isn't known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve according to the listed candidate that wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If the result of this election isn't known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

eventMetadata.context_description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro holds a slim edge in trader consensus for Brazil's October 4, 2026, presidential election first round, reflecting his rapid rise as the right-wing frontrunner backed by his father Jair Bolsonaro's enduring base, amid polls like AtlasIntel/Bloomberg (April 28) showing him tied with incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in simulated runoffs. Recent Datafolha and BTG Pactual/Nexus surveys confirm a neck-and-neck contest, with Lula leading some first-round scenarios but vulnerable due to economic pressures and fragmented opposition consolidation behind Flávio. A police probe into Flávio for alleged defamation against Lula adds risk, while upcoming candidate registrations and debates could tip the balance in this two-round system requiring over 50% to avoid a runoff.
